result:
Fixed. In `anthrouter/http_util.py`, `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` read `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`. The real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so the requests-remaining value was never recorded. I corrected the name.

The three rate-limit tests now pass: `test_admin_requests_reflects_a_dispatched_request`, `test_status_reports_the_last_rate_limit_window` and `test_successful_request_records_usage_and_the_rate_limit_window`. I didn't re-run the full suite after the fix, only those three.

Three other failures from the first full run are unrelated to the rate-limit window, and I left them alone:
- `test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields` in `tests/test_config.py`
- `test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier` in `tests/test_handlers.py`
- `test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock` in `tests/test_handlers.py`
